_note: Coordinates and elevations are APPROXIMATE and for general reference only. Verify with official sources, LGUs, and guides before any actual climb. Edit this file to add/correct entries.

mountains.name: Mount Pulag
mountains.notes: Highest peak in Luzon, third highest in the Philippines. Famous for its 'sea of clouds' and dwarf bamboo summit. Protected area under Mt. Pulag National Park.

mountains.name: Mount Tabayoc
mountains.notes: Second highest peak in Luzon. Dense, wet mossy forest within Mt. Pulag National Park. Often paired with the Four Lakes trek.

mountains.name: Mount Timbak (Singakalsa)
mountains.notes: Third highest in Luzon yet one of the most accessible — the trailhead sits along Halsema Highway. Known for vegetable terraces and roadside summit cross.

mountains.name: Mount Kalawitan
mountains.notes: One of the highest in the Cordillera with thick mossy forest and frequent fog. A classic Mountain Province climb.

mountains.name: Mount Amuyao
mountains.notes: Rugged peak overlooking the Barlig and Batad rice terraces. A demanding traverse route connects it toward Batad, Banaue.

mountains.name: Mount Napulauan
mountains.notes: Enchanting mossy 'fairy-tale' forest, often shrouded in mist. Historically linked to the WWII retreat of Gen. Yamashita.

mountains.name: Mount Tenglawan
mountains.notes: One of the 'Bakun Trio' peaks. Pine ridges, pitcher plants, and grassland summit views.

mountains.name: Mount Purgatory (Mangisi Range)
mountains.notes: Mossy-forest traverse across the Mangisi range (Bakian, Komkompol, Purgatory). Cool pine and mossy forest scenery.

mountains.name: Mount Ugo
mountains.notes: Classic pine-forest traverse passing remote mountain villages. A popular and scenic multi-day beginner-friendly climb.

mountains.name: Mount Sto. Tomas
mountains.notes: Overlooks Baguio City. Home to a pine and mossy forest and the historic 'Marlboro Country' grasslands.

mountains.name: Mount Kabunian
mountains.notes: Sacred mountain in Bakun cosmology with dramatic cliffs, hanging coffins, and waterfalls along the trail.

mountains.name: Mount Yangbew (Mt. Jumbo)
mountains.notes: Easy day-hike with 360° views of La Trinidad and Baguio. A great training and orientation hike for beginners.

mountains.name: Mount Kupapey
mountains.notes: Short sunrise climb famous for its sea of clouds over the Maligcong rice terraces.
